review.head: c07dda78c755f5e1e254457f49dfccc9dcae4e24
review.notes: Full review. Gate at this head fails: blob 5, sorry-data 20, imports 1, readme-ids-missing 4 (three are false positives: the names exist at the pins), outside-folder 2. Build passes; depcheck: 237 roadmaps, 2341 edges, 0 problems. The PR's own change, moving SA-B81-B84 to BanachSpaceTheory B5, is verified correct. Probes elaborated at the pins: three sorry'd definitions are constant in their arguments (rfl), and the negations of the statements of inner_proj and generator_genToGroup are proved in Lean (P1). The pinned Tau Ceti implements most of Parts A, C and D plus E28 and E32-E34 (about 30 targets mapped to file:line), and several Suggested.lean declarations close in one term (P2). VonNeumannAlgebras on main and at its open head owns V2.BorelCalculus, V4.0.Multiplication and V10.ClosedOperators, so those objects have two owners (P2). Four replacement headline statements without sorry'd data elaborate at the pins (P2 repair). Sampled source targets carry no locators; the six cited books are paywalled, so nothing could be fetched. Ownership was checked against open PRs 1027, 1771, 1041, 1015 and 1187.
